title: Protection Warrior in Forever
summary: Protection is Forever's tanking spec, using a one-handed weapon and shield to hold enemy attention and survive heavy hits.

strengths: Shield Slam is its highest-threat button and grows with Block Value
Sunder Armor stacks add threat on every spare global
Defensive talents keep mitigation and Rage generation high
Revenge comes up more often the better its avoidance
weaknesses: Gives up the damage of the two-handed and dual-wield specs
Needs healers to outlast sustained damage
Threat leans on Sunder Armor filling every other global
raid: Brings: Sunder Armor on the target, Thunder Clap's attack-speed slow and Demoralizing Shout

key.name: Shield Specialization
key.text: Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 5% and grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Block.
key.why: More Block chance, and every Block pays Rage. A block is no longer only mitigation: it feeds the Rage that Shield Slam, Revenge and Heroic Strike spend

key.name: Anticipation
key.why: Defense Skill, which raises avoidance and lowers the chance to be critically hit

key.name: Improved Revenge
key.text: Increases damage dealt by your Revenge ability by 60%.
key.why: Cheaper or harder-hitting versions of the three abilities that make most of a tank's threat

key.name: Improved Thunder Clap
key.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your Thunder Clap ability by 6.
key.why: Cheaper or harder-hitting versions of the three abilities that make most of a tank's threat

key.name: Improved Sunder Armor
key.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your Sunder Armor ability by 3.
key.why: Cheaper or harder-hitting versions of the three abilities that make most of a tank's threat

key.name: Last Stand
key.text: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.
key.why: A short burst of health, then it is lost again. An emergency button, not a damage-taken talent

key.name: Master of Defense
key.text: Grants you a 100% chance to generate 5 Rage when you Dodge or Parry while a shield is equipped.
key.why: Rage whenever you Dodge or Parry with a shield equipped, the avoidance counterpart of Shield Specialization

key.name: Defiance
key.text: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.
key.why: More threat in Defensive Stance while a shield is equipped, added on top of the stance's own threat bonus

key.name: Focused Rage
key.text: Reduces the Rage cost of your offensive abilities by 3.
key.why: Cheaper offensive abilities, so the Rage the talents above produce goes further

key.name: Bastion
key.text: Increases all damage you deal by 10% while a shield is equipped.
key.why: 10% more damage from everything you do while a shield is equipped, and so 10% more threat from your damage (the flat threat on Shield Slam, Sunder Armor and Heroic Strike does not scale with it)

key.name: Improved Bloodrage
key.text: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.
key.why: Half again as much Rage from Bloodrage

key.name: Concussion Blow
key.why: One point, because Shield Slam requires it

key.name: Shield Slam
key.text: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
key.why: The capstone: a shield hit that adds your Block Value, with very high threat

priority.name: Bloodrage
priority.clause: On cooldown while rage is under 60

priority.name: Thunder Clap
priority.clause: Keep Thunder Clap on the boss

cooldowns.name: Trinkets, racials and potions
cooldowns.clause: On cooldown, with your biggest damage
